title: Non-surgical foot fracture treatment (with / without manipulation)
description: Non-surgical foot fracture treatment is an outpatient procedure where your doctor treats your broken foot bones without surgery using a cast, boot, or specialized shoe. Your doctor will take X-rays to determine which foot bones are broken and assess the severity. Many foot fractures can heal without surgery if the bones are properly aligned. You'll wear protective footwear, usually a cast or walking boot, to immobilize your foot and allow healing. You'll need to avoid weight-bearing activities for several weeks, using crutches if necessary. Ice and elevation help manage swelling and pain. Periodic X-rays monitor healing progress. Physical therapy helps restore your strength and motion once healing is underway. Full healing typically takes 6-12 weeks depending on the fracture location and severity.
